assumptions.statement: All spatial layers use provisional boundaries from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. Official redline polygons are not yet published.
assumptions.impact: Area calculations, land-use ratios, and building footprints are indicative only. All must be recalculated after official boundary replacement.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, building heights, FAR, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for concept design; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Cultural heritage assets (Jingzhang Railway relics, Zhongguancun innovation history) are referenced from public knowledge and official announcement text, not from protected heritage surveys.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-themed design proposals are conceptual recommendations, not heritage impact assessments.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards describe future technology applications based on current trends. Technology maturity timelines are indicative.
assumptions.impact: Scenario feasibility requires separate technical validation and regulatory approval before implementation.

assumptions.statement: No specific enterprise names, investment amounts, or financial commitments are stated. Industry ecosystem references are based on public information about Haidian district.
assumptions.impact: Industry strategy is a framework recommendation, not an implementation plan.

risks.description: Provisional boundary replacement will require full recalculation of all geometry, metrics, and spatial analysis.
risks.mitigation: All files are structured for easy recalculation. Self-check flags provisional status.

risks.description: Without official regulatory plan data, the submission cannot demonstrate full regulatory compliance depth.
risks.mitigation: Compliance matrix explicitly marks items as concept_pending_official_data.

risks.description: Figure PNGs and PDF drawings are scaffold placeholders requiring professional graphic production.
risks.mitigation: HTML visualization provides interactive content; figures are marked as placeholder.
